reviews.title: Great widgets
reviews.text:
I am glad the new toolbar has become persistent so you can keep the month/day navigation visible across uses. 

I noticed that the app has now done away with the edge swipe/back gesture in settings and similar hierarchy of pages—this is terrible for reachability and runs against the iOS design conventions. It makes the user reach across to the far top edge of the device to navigate back, in 2026 I shouldn’t even need to scold a developer or describe the pain point for this, swipe back gesture has been best practice for many years now. Please bring back better navigation. 

Also, the edge swipe from the main calendar view brings up the agenda panel from the bottom, this is pretty jarring since you have a panel sliding up from the bottom (you swiped from the side) why not bring the panel animation sliding in from the side? This animation helps reinforce and teach where the gesture “lives,” by breaking this animation direction you’re making the app subtly harder to use.

But ever since Apple bought it I’ve had nonstop trouble with it. Granted, I kept the free version, so maybe that’s the problem. All I wanted was a simple calendar like I had. Now when I put in an event it looks fine until I exit the calendar. When I come back, all of my events are in there TWICE! So it looks like I have a million things to do! If I try to delete just one of them, they both get deleted! I’ve gone through & taken the time to delete & reenter EVERYTHING for 2 months, but then when I come back… it has done it again!!! Everything is there TWICE! I like being able to see 3 things at a glance that I have to do each day, but when things are entered twice, that can’t happen. And with ADHD, it feels so chaotic. This used to be such a great calendar for my ADHD with the color coding & simplicity, but I am so frustrated!!!

reviews.title: früher war nicht immer alles besser. Manchmal aber doch.
reviews.text:
Liebes Readdle Team,

ich kann nur eine wirkliche Verbesserung erkennen: Die Suchfunktion aus jeder Ansicht aktivieren zu können, hat schon lange gefehlt. Sehr gut. Das würde ich nicht mehr missen wollen.

Darüber hinaus muss ich mich leider der Einschätzung vieler anderer Nutzer anschließen. Ein Update macht eine App nicht immer besser. Die Darstellung wirkt jetzt unruhig und aufdringlich. 

*In der unteren Suchleiste ist die Taste „Heute“ unverständlicher weise verschwunden. Der heutige Tag wird jetzt durch Tippen auf Monat und Jahreszahl oben aufgerufen. Es hat etwas gedauert, bis ich das gefunden hatte. Die alte Suchleiste war übersichtlicher, von der Bedienung her auch *logischer. 

Früher konnte aus den über die Suche gefundenen Terminen ein Termin kopiert werden, um ihn an einem anderen Tag einzusetzen. Für mich eine sehr oft genutzte Funktion, da ich wiederkehrende Termine mit geändertem Text fortschreibe. 
Diese Funktion ist leider verloren gegangen. In der aktuellen Version kann ich die gefundenen Termine nur bearbeiten und löschen. Im Vergleich zum Apple-Kalender war die einfach zu bedienende Kopierfunktion der Hauptvorteil. 

Grüße Günter

reviews.title: Unreliable Dates and Alerts
reviews.text:
I relied on this app every day and paid $21.99 per year, but it ultimately caused more problems than it solved. All-day events entered for a specific date were syncing to Outlook one day early, which also caused alerts to arrive on the wrong day. This is a serious issue for anyone depending on a calendar for bills, appointments, work, and family events.

I thoroughly checked every possible setting: my iPhone date and time were set automatically, all time zones were set correctly, Apple’s Time Zone Override was off, and the correct account was connected. I force-synced, closed and reopened both apps, and signed out and back in. I also created multiple test events. An event entered for September 3 repeatedly appeared in Outlook on September 2. After signing out and back in, some of my existing events moved around as well.

I tested the same type of event directly in Apple Calendar, and it remained on the correct date after closing and reopening the app. Unfortunately, none of my troubleshooting resolved the problem with this app. A paid calendar should make scheduling more dependable—not create uncertainty about whether important events and alerts are on the correct day.

reviews.title: Abzocke
reviews.text:
Ich benutze diesen Kalender seit Jahren und war bisher auch immer zufrieden. Sehr sogar nach dem Erstkauf für 5,99 € kam eine Zeit später trotz Wiederherstellung der Käufe erneut die Aufforderung den Kalender zu kaufen. Beim erneuten Kauf war der Betrag deutlich teurer!! 

Als ob dies nicht genug sei, musste ich, um den Kalender zu nutzen letztes Jahr ein Jahresabo abschließen. Selbstverständlich. Für den Anbieter der App war zudem die nicht kostenpflichtige Variante der App in seiner Funktionsweise deutlich einzuschränken, so dass man mehr oder weniger gezwungen wurde auf die teure kostenpflichtige Abo Variante umzusteigen. 

Es scheint sich bei vielen Anbietern, so auch hier, die Gewohnheit breit gemacht zu haben, den Kunden durch Preissteigerung und langfristige Kundenbindung durch Abonnements abzuzocken. Ich werde mein aktuelles Abonnement nicht verlängern und in Zukunft zum Google Kalender, der ja kostenfrei ist, wechseln. Ironie dabei: Kalender Enders bedient sich letztendlich auch des Google Kalender Enders, der nur optisch anders aufbereitet wird, aber im Hintergrund hinterlegt ist.

Fazit: ich rate dringend davon ab diese App zu kaufen oder zu abonnieren und den Google Kalender zu nutzen, der kostenfrei ist und genauso Functional. Ich war viele Jahre lang, sehr begeistert von dieser App, bin aber umso enttäuscht da, dass der Anbieter sich entschlossen hat, den Profit über die Kundenzufriedenheit zu stellen!

reviews.title: Lost Everything
reviews.text:
I’ve been using Readdle’s calendar app, and older versions of it, for a lot of years. However a few days ago, my entire calendar was wiped.
I have already spent hours troubleshooting on my own and also messaging with app support. They say they don’t store any information and it’s an Apple issue. So I spent hours troubleshooting, messaging, and on the phone with Apple. They haven’t been able to fix the problem because it’s a third party app.
So I’ve lost years worth of information, past and future. Information I refer back to regularly. And it seems that I’m not the only one this has happened to either. 
I’m giving the app two stars because up until now I’ve really enjoyed using it, though have become frustrated with the choice to make it a subscription service. But when all my data disappears and there is no real support, just passing the buck, especially because this has happened to other users, Readdle needs to do better.

reviews.title: What a disappointment!
reviews.text:
UPDATE:
Just got a response from the developer asking if I could send them details about the problem. Hilarious. What don't you understand about this review?!

ORIGINAL REVIEW:
I canceled my subscription immediately after discovering that, for some bizarre reason, they chose to use the old-fashioned scrolling wheel date picker instead of a quick and easy month view, like every other advanced calendar has. When you scroll the day number column, it's impossible to know what day of the week you're on until you stop scrolling and it shows at the top. Just see how long it takes you to find next Thursday, or the third Tuesday of the month. This is absolutely insane. It brings productivity to a screeching halt. A month view date picker lets you see all of these options at a glance and allows you to select what you want with a single tap. For heaven's sake, ditch, the stupid scrolling wheels!

Also, when entering a new task, you have to save the task first and then go back into it to edit recurring and other options. Again, a total waste of time.

Huge disappointment from Readdle, whose Spark email and Scanner Pro I own and use every day.

reviews.title: Data Lost
reviews.text: I’m devastated. I’ve been using this app for 13 years and had everything in my life stored here: birthdays, anniversaries, appointments, trips, any and every important memory has been logged here. All of a sudden this morning, the app was wiped clean. It seems an update was done 23 hours ago. The troubleshooting options aren’t applicable as I don’t connect this app to other calendars. Aside from self help articles, an AI bot is the only other option to reach out to and the only advice is that this app is not stand alone but synched with other calendars. I only enter everything directly into the app and was not aware this app does not store any data. There’s no way to connect with anyone but even if I could it seems everything is gone and I can’t get it back. Now that I’m reading other reviews, I’m not the only one who’s lost everything. Be very careful using this app
